record.hypothesis: The host experiment processed 192,000 float64 samples through four 513-tap impulse responses using identical 2,048-point overlap-save blocks. The separate path recomputed the source FFT four times per block; the candidate computed it once and reused X for four IFFT(X  H_k) outputs. The outputs had 0.0 maximum absolute difference. Median times over seven alternating runs were 17.80 ms separate versus 12.33 ms shared, a 1.44× speedup, with the same 512-sample algorithmic history/latency. This is a host numerical component result, not a browser audio-device benchmark.
